strategies.name: Naive Loop-Based Eight All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Directly implements the reference logic with 8 sequential all_reduce calls, each preceded by bidiagonal coupling and followed by inverse coupling. Dispatch count = 8 all-reduces. Represents the baseline: simple structure with maximum dispatch overhead but minimal local computation complexity.

strategies.name: Fused Coupling with Batched All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Horizontally fuse multiple stages by concatenating the intermediate buffers into a single larger tensor and performing fewer all-reduce operations (e.g., 2-4 dispatches handling multiple stages). Trades increased local memory footprint and tensor concatenation overhead for reduced collective dispatch count, exploiting potential NIC bandwidth amortization.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Replace each all-reduce with reduce_scatter followed by all_gather, allowing overlap of the bidiagonal coupling computation with the all_gather phase. Dispatch count = 16 (8 RS + 8 AG). Exposes computation-communication overlap opportunities at the cost of doubling the number of collective primitives, beneficial when local ops dominate.

strategies.name: Pipelined Coupling with Ring Communication
strategies.desc: Manually implement a ring-based reduction where each rank performs local bidiagonal coupling on partial sums as they arrive from neighbors, avoiding full all-reduce. Dispatch count = O(world_size) point-to-point operations per stage. Trades global synchronization for asynchronous neighbor exchanges, reducing synchronization barriers.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction with Node-Local Fusion
strategies.desc:
Exploit the multi-node topology by first performing node-local all-reduce (or shared-memory reduction), applying bidiagonal coupling at node granularity, then cross-node all-reduce. Dispatch count = 16 (8 intra-node + 8 inter-node). Optimizes for NUMA/network hierarchy by reducing cross-node traffic and leveraging faster intra-node bandwidth.
